name: fade-in
title: Fade in
description: A wrapper that fades and lifts its content in once when it enters view, with direction, delay and duration. Visible without JavaScript and under reduced motion.
docs: Reveal is tied to the scroll position; FadeIn plays on its own clock, which suits cards and copy the reader will not scrub. The server renders the block fully visible, so nothing is hidden without JavaScript or before hydration. A block that is already on screen when the page hydrates stays as it is; one that mounts in the browser, such as a route change or a conditional, always plays. Use delay to line a row of blocks up. Only opacity and transform move, so layout never shifts, and reduced motion and print show everything at rest.
